titleEn: Maximum Number of Events That Can Be Attended
title: 最多可以参加的会议数目
summary: 每个事件可在其起止日期内任选一天参加且每天最多一个，求最多参加事件数。
insight: 按开始日排序；每天把已开始事件的结束日放入最小堆，丢弃过期事件并参加结束最早的一场，为后续保留最大余地。堆空时可直接跳到下个开始日。
pitfalls: 过期结束日小于当前日期

solutions.title: 最早结束事件堆
solutions.idea: 逐日优先消费截止最紧的可用事件。
steps: 按 start 排序，index=0、day=0、answer=0，小根堆存 end
当仍有事件或堆非空：堆空则 day=max(day,nextStart)；加入所有 start<=day 的 end，弹出 end<day
若堆非空，弹出一个参加，answer++、day++；返回 answer

code.java: class Solution { public int maxEvents(int[][] events){Arrays.sort(events,Comparator.comparingInt(event->event[0]));PriorityQueue<Integer> ends=new PriorityQueue<>();int index=0,day=0,answer=0;while(index<events.length||!ends.isEmpty()){if(ends.isEmpty())day=Math.max(day,events[index][0]);while(index<events.length&&events[index][0]<=day)ends.offer(events[index++][1]);while(!ends.isEmpty()&&ends.peek()<day)ends.poll();if(!ends.isEmpty()){ends.poll();answer++;day++;}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maxEvents(events:Array<IntArray>):Int{events.sortBy{it[0]};val ends=java.util.PriorityQueue<Int>();var index=0;var day=0;var answer=0;while(index<events.size||ends.isNotEmpty()){if(ends.isEmpty())day=maxOf(day,events[index][0]);while(index<events.size&&events[index][0]<=day)ends.add(events[index++][1]);while(ends.isNotEmpty()&&ends.peek()<day)ends.poll();if(ends.isNotEmpty()){ends.poll();answer++;day++}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int maxEvents(vector<vector<int>>& events){sort(events.begin(),events.end());priority_queue<int,vector<int>,greater<int>> ends;int index=0,day=0,answer=0;while(index<(int)events.size()||!ends.empty()){if(ends.empty())day=max(day,events[index][0]);while(index<(int)events.size()&&events[index][0]<=day)ends.push(events[index++][1]);while(!ends.empty()&&ends.top()<day)ends.pop();if(!ends.empty()){ends.pop();++answer;++day;}}return answer;} };
